tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2604P is a professional-grade IP phone designed for businesses, call centers, and service providers that require reliable and scalable voice communication. Featuring 3 lines, 6 SIP accounts, integrated PoE, HD audio, and Gigabit Ethernet ports, the GRP2604P delivers exceptional performance for modern office environments. It supports zero-touch provisioning and centralized device management through Grandstream's GDMS platform, making large-scale deployments simple and efficient.

With advanced noise reduction technology, full-duplex speakerphone, and 5-way audio conferencing, the GRP2604P ensures crystal-clear communication while enhancing team collaboration. The integrated PoE support eliminates the need for a separate power adapter, reducing cable clutter and simplifying installation.


Key Features

  • Supports 3 Lines and 6 SIP Accounts
  • Integrated IEEE 802.3af PoE
  • Dual Gigabit Ethernet Ports
  • HD Audio Handset and Speakerphone
  • 5-Way Audio Conferencing
  • AI Noise Reduction & Noise Shield Technology
  • 2.7-inch Backlit LCD Display
  • EHS Support for Jabra, Plantronics & Sennheiser Headsets
  • Zero-Touch Provisioning & GDMS Cloud Management
  • Enterprise-Grade Security Protection
  • Wall Mountable Design
  • Swappable Faceplate for Custom Branding
